text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family boasts a long-distance specialist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Specifically, a magnificent stayer who won the Kikuka Sho and the spring Tenno Sho back-to-back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Bright. Am I to understand that you'd like me to take charge of your long-distance training?
choice_data_list: Yeah. We need your help, Mejiro McQueen.
Yeah. We need your help, Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I humbly request your coaching. I shall do whatever it takes to ensure my performance at the Kikuka Sho is sublime…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I wish to contribute as gloriously as you have to the Mejiro name, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To contribute to the Mejiro name… Bright, I am aware that you've been yearning to do that for years.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Very well. I shall lend you my assistance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Mejiro McQueen-led long-distance training regimen gets underway…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, pant, huff… McQueen, I have never run for so long in my life…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My heart is pounding like a drum, and everything around me is spinning… I can hardly breathe…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's because your cardiopulmonary system is struggling to keep up. The burden placed on it by the spring and fall Classics is on an entirely different level, you see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As such, if you are to perform well in each of the Triple Crown races, you must break through the wall that stands before you this summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is 2,400 meters, and the Kikuka Sho 3,000. You'll be needing a great deal of stamina to conquer that 600-meter difference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: During my time competing in the Classics, I ignored the spring Classics and focused exclusively on the Kikuka Sho and the spring Tenno Sho. In other words…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was able to win precisely because I began specializing in long-distance races very early on. To put it yet another way…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If one who has yet to specialize is to perform well, they must completely transform both their mind and body over the course of the summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And Bright, judging from your running in the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby, you do strike me as a runner suited to medium distances, much like Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, if you are to begin your climb to the sheer heights I scaled, you must be prepared to shoulder a great burden.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Have you the drive necessary to overcome that pain and achieve your goal?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The drive… to achieve my goal…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Of course… I have the drive. I am more profoundly, fiercely, and utterly determined than anyone else in the world. And it's because I've a reason to be…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is it because that's how fully you wish to devote yourself to the Mejiro family?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I don't wish simply for that alone… I wish to become its new light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A light that can illuminate even further beyond the paradigm that you and Ryan have set.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: As one who has always been a burden, I feel it is imperative that I exert myself to the absolute limit. Otherwise, I'll fail to become even the faintest of sparkles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pushing yourself "to the absolute limit" to become the "new light"…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, Bright has expressed quite the ambition, but do I have your permission to push her to her absolute limit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Because coaching her properly will entail running her mind and body ragged. Knowing this, will you allow me to go ahead with it?
choice_data_list: Yes, give her what she needs.
Yes, give her what she needs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I answer without hesitation. She'll probably suffer at first, and come close to collapse before we're done, but even then…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know Mejiro Bright will make it all work out in the end. That's just who she is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Your faith is unwavering, I see. And your willingness to wait for Bright is similarly valuable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Very well. Let's get started, Bright. You're still a great distance from where you need to be. Come along now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes… Lead the way, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days pass…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I feel I've finally gotten accustomed to this running style, McQueen. Do you feel I've improved at all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes… Bright, you've…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing. But to think you'd come this far…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, the time has come to fine-tune your technique. Your final test… is to face me in an exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But let's have a little fun with it. Trainer, in which manner of event should we compete?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives me two options. I think Mejiro Bright should go head-to-head with Mejiro McQueen in…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wrestling… I accept. A sport in which competitors are sent crashing against the sand the moment their stamina is depleted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let's get changed, Bright. We can hardly wrestle dressed as we are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let's go over the rules. Grabbing one another's swimsuits is against the rules. We are to grasp only for the arms, legs, and waist. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, show me what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… La la laaa…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-what are you doing? Why is your stance so lackadaisical?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ha-yah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What?! You transitioned from that casual stance to a tackle?! Were you trying to catch me off guard?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's elusively floaty movements might not be a deliberate wrestling tactic, but they leave Mejiro McQueen utterly unable to fight back…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… You put up quite the fight. I'd say your wrestling today really shows how far you've come.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you very much. Though, I appear to have gotten sand everywhere…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the wrestling match between the Mejiros is decided, with Mejiro Bright leaving the ring stronger than when she stepped in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Long-distance swimming… Very well. This will constitute an entirely different challenge from running on solid ground.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We shall begin the moment we've changed into our swimsuits, Bright. We'll race to that island and back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the long-distance swimming race begins. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She's slow… She's terribly slow. I finished quite some time ago, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What in the world is she doing? No, don't tell me something's happened to her…
choice_data_list: Give her a few more minutes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If this were anyone else, I'd be worried—but this is Mejiro Bright we're talking about. Her taking this long seems about right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's when…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Whew… Sorry I took so long, McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. I thought so. I've lost, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bright! What happened out there?! Are you all right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, I got swept up in rather a strong current along the way and found myself bobbing about a bit…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Surely you don't mean the rip current?! And then what happened?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, I thought that was part of the test as well. So I let the current carry me off, and then when it was finished…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I had a nice, casual swim back over here. Thanks to all your training, McQueen, I had the stamina to make it through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You let yourself drift away on purpose? Sigh… I'm not sure whether that was careless or incredibly bold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But I'm glad to see that you're safe. And Trainer, I must say you're doing a terrific job of matching Bright's pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen delivers her compliment with a forced smile. It seems as if the unexpected developments of the swimming competition have boosted Mejiro Bright's mental fortitude.
